instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Check a contract for work taken from a reference (a source ported, a behaviour ported, a visual replica, an inspiration, an anti-reference): the source and its identity, what must be preserved, and the proof (retained source lines, required mechanisms, measured pictures and pixel difference)", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:check-a-reference-adaptation-contract and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give contract (the contract itself) or contract_file (a path inside the folder the person granted for reading), stage (pre-edit before the work starts, completion, the default, when it is done) and optionally target (a path the contract must own).
